slides.say: n is an odd number. Which of the following is the most precise description of nine n squared minus one, over four?
A division with parity, and the choices are descriptions. [short pause] We'll solve it two ways, plugging in three times, and then with the shortcut formula.
[short pause] Let's start by plugging in. It's a division, so three plug-ins, close together, and n has to be odd. n is one. Nine times one is nine, minus one is eight, and eight over four is two.
n is three. Nine times nine is eighty-one, minus one is eighty, and eighty over four is twenty.
n is five. Nine times twenty-five is two twenty-five, minus one is two twenty-four, and over four is fifty-six.
Two, twenty, fifty-six, even every time. That points to choice number one, always even. But plug-ins that work don't prove always, so let's see why.
at: That points to choice number one

slides.say: [pause] Nine n squared is three n, squared, and one is one squared. So it's the third shortcut formula, three n minus one, times three n plus one.
at: Nine n squared is three n

slides.say: n is odd, so three n is odd too. So three n minus one and three n plus one are the even numbers just before and just after it, two consecutive even numbers. And remember, two consecutive evens always divide by eight.
